messages:
olga: FYI, after the role-schema refactor rollout (last deploy) I've noticed ~1200 users in the 'propagation_pending' queue for >3 hours. Monitoring shows 502s from auth-service when trying to evaluate default roles.
maria: ouch. where's the propagation job running? dedicated migrator pool or on the regular worker fleet?
olga: migrator pool. job id: migrator/2026-05-18/role-prop-03
jonathan: I'm seeing similar 502s in traces: auth-service -> kms-client -> key-lookup times out. Could be the KMS alias rotation that happened at 03:10 UTC.
kevin: @olga can you paste the exact error from the migrator logs? I want to see DB constraint vs KMS timeouts.
olga: pasted snippet:
```
ERROR RolePropagator - failed to mark propagated for role_id=rb_24: pq: update or delete on table "roles" violates foreign key constraint "fk_role_assignments_role_id" on table "role_assignments"
Caused by: KMSError: key alias not found (after retry)
```
maria: two separate things: FK violation suggests a concurrent delete or id churn during the schema change; KMSError suggests the migrator couldn't decrypt a signed token to update assignments. Could be correlated (if delete path tried to re-create roles).
jonathan: I ran a quick query:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM role_assignments WHERE propagated IS NULL AND attempted_at < now() - interval '1 hour';
-- returns 1237
```
kevin: Also check if any transactions are stuck holding the roles table lock. Try:
```
SELECT pid, query, state, wait_event_type, wait_event FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE now() - query_start > '5 minutes'::interval;
```
olga: good call, found a long-running session from migrator that is idle in transaction with an open cursor. PID 17342. That session holds a ROW EXCLUSIVE lock on roles.
maria: we should avoid a blind kill without coordination. But we need throughput. Suggest steps:
1) pause propagation job (feature-flag) to stop new workers
2) snapshot pending rows to an escrow table for safety
3) try to safely kill the offending PG session after verifying the migrator has no critical in-flight ops
4) re-run a guarded backfill with smaller batch size and KMS retry bump
kevin: +1. Also add a KMS sanity check to the migrator pre-run: call kms:DescribeKey and fail fast if alias missing.
jonathan: audit note: we saw ~700 audit events for role_assign change attempts that never made it to the audit log because audit-batcher crashed during the same window. audit-bot: wrote 500 errors 03:12-03:25 UTC.
audit-bot: Confirmed. Errors were HTTP 502 to audit-ingest. We're missing some events for that 13-minute window. We should mark that as an incident and include it in post-incident review.
olga: I'm going to flip the propagation FF now. curl internal-config ->
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://internal-config.local/flags/role_propagation/pause
```
olga: paused. stopping new jobs.
kevin: I've created an escrow table and copied the pending rows:
```
INSERT INTO role_assignments_escrow SELECT * FROM role_assignments WHERE propagated IS NULL LIMIT 5000;
```
kevin: next I'll attempt to kill PID 17342 after verifying it isn't in the middle of a multi-table delete.
jonathan: also start a KMS alias health check job (one-off):
```
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood/prod/roles
```
jonathan: returns KeyNotFound earlier; CC to infra to investigate rotation hooks.
maria: infra pager: @kevin @olga please include them. Kevin, if KMS not found, do not re-run backfill until key restored or a fallback key is configured.
kevin: acknowledged. I'm holding on kill; sending note to infra on-call.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-05-18-role-schema-refactor finished at 03:09 UTC. No automatic rollback triggered.
infra-oncall (olga): responding — we rotated alias yesterday but replication to secondary clusters lagged; alias wasn't propagated to the region where migrator runs. Fixing now.
olga: infra confirmed alias propagation fix in progress. once alias exists we can re-run a small canary backfill.
maria: action items:
- infra: confirm alias replication and notify (infra-oncall)
- security/migrator: add preflight KMS DescribeKey check and bump KMS retries (kevin)
- db: investigate the FK violation path and add safe-delete invariants (jonathan)
- ops: mark missing audit events as incomplete and run audit-replay from escrow (olga + audit-bot)
kevin: I'll also implement an idempotent escrow apply: when reapplying, skip rows where role_id no longer exists and log them for manual review.
jonathan: re: FK violation — early hypothesis: role deletions during the refactor used a different id sharding which produced transient orphan refs. I'll post the migration diff in #eng-arch.
olga: timeline: paused at 03:19, infra fixes at 03:43, started a 100-row canary at 03:50 after KMS showed DESCRIBE success, canary succeeded. started rate-limited apply at 03:55.
maria: good recovery. open question: we lost ~700 audit events — we need to surface this to compliance and document compensation steps.
olga: will draft an incident note and include proposed mitigation (audit-retry backoff, escrow replay, KMS preflight). Adding to incidents channel after this thread.
kevin: thanks team. I'll follow up with a PR for migrator preflight and a test that simulates alias-not-found.
jonathan: I'll add DB-level check to prevent deletes that would orphan role_assignments during migrations (defer cascade until escrow is clear).
maria: closing loop — please drop a short summary in #eng-security/incidents and tag legal/compliance for audit gap. :white_check_mark:
olga: summary posted to incidents. closing this thread.
